title: miRNA to Guide Appropriate Intervention of Small Testis Masses
official: miRNA as a Liquid Biomarker to Guide Early Detection and Appropriate Intervention of Incidentally Detected Small Testicular Masses
summary: This study aims to determine, for the first time, if miRNA-371a-3p can be used as an accurate biomarker to identify which small (≤ 2cm) testicular masses are malignant and aid in clinical decision-making to offer surgery or surveillance. We propose a retrospective exploration of banked serum, plasma and semen specimens of men with small testis masses and a prospective biomarker-based intervention trial to validate miR-371a-3p performance.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* • Small testicular mass/masses ≤ 2cm

  * Patients with serum tumour marker elevation are eligible only if they are considered for surgical treatment, or if markers are felt to be falsely elevated by the physician team
  * If the patient previously had chemotherapy, the mass must first have appeared only after the treatment completed
  * The patient is at least 18 years of age
  * Ability to understand and comply with the requirements of the study
  * Ability to understand and willingness to sign a written informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* • Patients with testicular tumours \> 2 cm

  * Metastatic disease
  * Patients in reduced general condition, with uncontrolled intercurrent illnesses, or with life-threatening disease
  * Patients with psychiatric illnesses that would limit compliance with study requirements
  * Clinical decision is made by the multidisciplinary team that patient is not suitable for surveillance
